Register A2 intra-domain group rules

Source: R/topology_rules_a2.R
register_topology_a2.Rd

Register A2 intra-domain group rules

Usage

register_topology_a2(
  domain,
  key_vars,
  site_var = "group_id",
  subject_var = "entity_id",
  dup_rate_threshold = 0.1,
  missing_vars = character(),
  missingness_threshold = 0.1,
  max_events = 20,
  lab_test_var = "test_code",
  lab_value_var = "value",
  min_lab_repeats = 3,
  event_flag_var = NULL,
  outlier_k = 3,
  skew_value_var = NULL,
  skew_threshold = 2,
  owner_team = "Data Stewardship",
  overwrite = FALSE
)

Arguments

domain

Domain name.

key_vars

Key variables for duplicate checks.

site_var

Site/group variable.

subject_var

Subject variable.

dup_rate_threshold

Threshold for duplicate-rate rules.

missing_vars

Variables for missingness checks.

missingness_threshold

Threshold for missingness checks.

max_events

Maximum events per subject.

lab_test_var

Lab test variable for GRP-003.

lab_value_var

Lab value variable for GRP-003.

min_lab_repeats

Minimum repeats for GRP-003.

event_flag_var

Optional event flag for GRP-004.

outlier_k

Robust z-score threshold for GRP-004.

skew_value_var

Numeric variable for GRP-005.

skew_threshold

Absolute skewness threshold for GRP-005.

owner_team

Owner team.

overwrite

Whether to overwrite existing IDs.

Value

Invisibly returns registered IDs.

Details

Equivalent to pack_topology_a2(...) followed by register_rule() for each produced rule.
